newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission's strategic assessments draft delayed one week.
newsitem.headline: Commission's strategic assessments draft delayed one week.

text.p: The European Commission postponed on Wednesday its plans to adopt a proposal on strategic environmental assessments, with one official citing the day's over-full agenda as the cause of the delay.

Discussions in Commissioners' cabinets have centred on whether the proposal should be for a directive or a regulation, with Environment Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard's preference being for the former, one official said.

Another outstanding point is whether to base the proposal on the EC Treaty's Article 130s paragraph 1 or paragraph 2, the first requiring a qualified majority in the Council of Ministers and the latter unanimity.
Again, Bjerregaard wants the former, the official said.
